boltz.evidence: 1 seed vs a 5-seed Boltz-derived reference: it re-measures itself (seeds correlate 0.77-0.93), so its sensitivity is inflated and its false positives are seed noise. Recovers 1 of 4 solved TNF binders.

af3.evidence: 5-sample mean; both models >= 0.5 recovered 1/5 reference passes at 0/15 false positives; 0/4 solved binders. ~36 s/design batched (60-75 s per-design process). Its 0.5 gate is uncalibrated.

ptx.evidence: Protenix-v2: both models >= 0.5 recovered 3/5 reference passes at 0/15 false positives; 0/5 solved binders. Non-default alternative to AF3.

of3.why: no signal: exactly 0.0 interface confidence on every solved binder and every reference pass although it uses the MSA (bare trimer pTM 0.91 with, 0.24 without)
of3.evidence: ipTM and ipSAE at PAE cutoffs 10-30 A all uncorrelated or inverse vs the reference. The benchmark ranking that favoured it on other targets did not transfer.

ptx_fast.why: no usable signal on the trimer: ipSAE is exactly 0 for 89% of designs (82% of the designs Boltz-2 passes), AUROC 0.56 for Boltz-2 >= 0.5, top 30% recovers 38% (random 30%), 0/5 reference passers, 0/4 solved binders
ptx_fast.evidence: 269 designs in one batch (95 Boltz>=0.5 + 150 random lower + 20 reference + 4 real binders). Its single-chain calibration (AUROC 0.62-0.65 vs wet-lab labels, Spearman 0.43-0.59 vs Boltz-2, 3-5x enrichment) did not transfer to the 471-residue homotrimer; ~11x cheaper does not matter when the score is zero.
